test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

If G # H & I @ J & K, then how is H related to J?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

**Given: **

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Symbol denoted Relation**
 
 

 @
 Husband
 
 

 &
 Mother
 
 

 #
 Daughter
 
 

**Given: **G # H & I @ J & K

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bb110aa297efe7dfce06720fbb2416f988a968d2d4930275ffea5b0be84a24e.png] 

Clearly, Here H is the **mother-in-law **of J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Mother-in-law".**
